0Prosumer%20Portfolios**%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20Across%20all%2014%20pools%2C%20**weekend%20consumption%20is%205%25%20to%2013%25%20HIGHER%20than%20weekday%20consumption**%20(retention%20ratio%3A%201.05%20to%201.13).%20Commercial%20offices%20drop%2030%E2%80%9350%25%20on%20weekends%3B%20continuous%20industry%20is%20flat%20(1.0).%20Residential%20households%20consume%20more%20on%20weekends%20due%20to%20home%20occupancy%2C%20appliance%20use%2C%20and%20heating.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Behind-The-Meter%20Self-Consumption**%3A%20In%20all%20pools%2C%20metered%20grid%20import%20dips%20to%20its%20daily%20low%20at%2010%3A00%20UTC%20(~180%20kW)%20because%20rooftop%20solar%20directly%20powers%20household%20appliances%20on-site%20before%20exporting%20surplus%20power.%20Grid%20import%20peaks%20at%2018%3A00%20UTC%20(~384%20kW)%20as%20the%20sun%20sets%20and%20evening%20domestic%20routines%20begin.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Electrified%20Space%20Heating**%3A%20Winter%20consumption%20is%20**2.3%C3%97%20to%202.9%C3%97%20higher**%20than%20spring%20consumption%20across%20all%20pools%2C%20demonstrating%20widespread%20adoption%20of%20electric%20heat%20pumps.%0A%0A%20%20%20%203.%20**Physical%20Feeder%20Hierarchy%20(Substation%20to%20Cul-de-Sac)**%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20The%20pools%20represent%20physical%20electrical%20topology%20rather%20than%20arbitrary%20statistical%20clusters%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Primary%20Substation%20Hub%20(Pool%200)**%3A%20Peak%20load%20of%206.1%20MW%20and%20peak%20solar%20of%2014.6%20MW%20(~1%2C500%2B%20households).%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Secondary%20Substation%20Feeder%20(Pool%2011)**%3A%20Peak%20load%20of%202.1%20MW%20and%20peak%20solar%20of%206.9%20MW%20(~500%20households).%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Standard%20Neighborhood%20Feeders%20(Pools%203%2C%205%2C%207%2C%209%2C%2010%2C%2014%2C%2015)**%3A%20Peak%20loads%20between%20440%20kW%20and%20920%20kW%20(~100%E2%80%93200%20households).%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Micro-Feeders%20%2F%20Cul-de-sacs%20(Pools%201%2C%202%2C%204%2C%208%2C%2013)**%3A%20Peak%20loads%20between%20200%20kW%20and%20335%20kW%20(~30%E2%80%9360%20households).%0A%0A%20%20%20%204.%20**The%20Solar%20Duck%20Curve%20%26%20Reverse%20Power%20Flow%20Congestion**%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20In%20January%2C%20all%2014%20feeders%20are%20steady%20**net%20importers**%20(%2B0.2%C3%97%20to%20%2B0.4%C3%97%20of%20peak%20winter%20capacity).%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20In%20May%2C%20solar%20production%20dramatically%20overwhelms%20local%20demand%2C%20flipping%20**every%20single%20feeder%20into%20a%20massive%20net%20exporter**.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20**Critical%20Congestion%20Hotspots%20(Pools%207%20and%2010)**%3A%20Peak%20solar%20generation%20is%20**4.06%C3%97%20to%204.41%C3%97%20larger**%20than%20peak%20local%20consumption.%20At%20midday%20in%20May%2C%20these%20feeders%20back-feed%20**-2.2%C3%97%20to%20-2.5%C3%97%20their%20maximum%20winter%20demand**%20up%20through%20distribution%20transformers%20into%20the%20medium-voltage%20grid.%0A%0A%20%20%20%205.%20**Why%20Splitting%20the%20Pools%20is%20Operationally%20Essential**%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20If%20the%2014%20pools%20were%20lumped%20into%20a%20single%20aggregate%20portfolio%2C%20the%20severe%20local%20overvoltage%20and%20reverse-flow%20congestion%20on%20Feeders%207%20and%2010%20would%20be%20masked%20by%20the%20heavier%20absorption%20on%20Feeder%200.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20-%20By%20maintaining%2014%20separate%20pools%2C%20the%20DSO%20and%20battery%20optimizer%20can%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%201.%20Accurately%20model%20transformer%20headroom%20on%20individual%20distribution%20branches.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%202.%20Strategically%20dispatch%20local%20battery%20storage%20or%20demand%20response%20to%20absorb%20excess%20midday%20solar%20directly%20where%20the%20feeder%20is%20congested.%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%203.%20Monetize%20localized%20flexibility%20and%20participate%20in%20DSO%20congestion%20rel
